notes: Dates on the site are given as 'CET'. Stored as ISO with the real Berlin offset (+02:00 while summer time is on, until 25 Oct; +01:00 after).

productId is OUR assumption — the site does not say which product a webinar belongs to. Mapping: investing → invest, AI → tech, the other two → unlimited (only Unlimited includes 'all webinars'). This is a question for the client.
Status (upcoming/past) is NOT stored: the block computes it from startsAt vs. now.
image = the card photo from the-chat.io (Tilda CDN), matched by column: each photo sits directly above its webinar's text.
